title: GaugeQuant: Online Learning of Quantization-Optimal Bases from LLM Symmetries
abstract: arXiv:2607.20757v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Transformers are known to have internal continuous symmetries that leave outputs invariant while altering how activations are distributed across coordinates, and hence how well they quantize. GaugeQuant leverages this in-training by introducing a LogSumExp term to the loss that breaks the symmetries, thus selecting a basis that minimizes activation outliers. A stop-gradient operator ensures that only rotation matrices are updated, yielding the language modeling objective completely unaltered. Our quantization strategy requires no specific calibration data, no quantization simulation, and adds a small inference overhead. As a proof of concept, we evaluate on WikiText-2 perplexity and zero-shot reasoning. On Qwen-2.5 0.5B, GaugeQuant reduces perplexity (e.g. $25.62 \to 16.76$ under W4A16) and improves zero-shot accuracy. On LLaMA-2 7B, perplexity improves but downstream accuracy does not. The code is available at: https://github.

translated_title: GaugeQuant：从大语言模型对称性中在线学习量化最优基
translated_abstract: 众所周知，Transformer具有内部连续对称性，这种对称性在保持输出不变的同时会改变激活值在各坐标维度上的分布方式，从而影响其量化效果。GaugeQuant在训练过程中利用了这一特性，通过在损失函数中引入一个LogSumExp项来打破这种对称性，从而选择出使激活离群值最小化的基。梯度停止（stop-gradient）算子确保只有旋转矩阵被更新，使语言建模目标完全不受影响。我们的量化策略不需要特定的校准数据，不需要量化模拟，且仅增加很小的推理开销。作为概念验证，我们在WikiText-2困惑度和零样本推理任务上进行了评估。在Qwen-2.5 0.5B上，GaugeQuant降低了困惑度（例如在W4A16设置下从25.62降至16.76）并提高了零样本准确率。在LLaMA-2 7B上，困惑度有所改善，但下游准确率没有提升。代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.
tldr: GaugeQuant通过在训练中向损失函数引入LogSumExp项打破Transformer的内部连续对称性，在线学习出最小化激活离群值的量化最优基，无需校准数据和量化模拟即可显著提升低比特量化效果。
en_tdlr: GaugeQuant breaks Transformers' internal continuous symmetries during training via a LogSumExp loss term, learning quantization-optimal bases online that minimize activation outliers, achieving improved low-bit quantization without calibration data or quantization simulation.
